T1046.name: Network Service Discovery / Port Scan
T1046.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts to identify vulnerable targets.

T1110.name: Brute Force Credentials
T1110.description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts by systematically trying passwords.

T1498.name: Network Denial of Service
T1498.description: Adversaries may perform Network DoS attacks to degrade or disrupt service availability.

T1059.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
T1059.description: Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute arbitrary commands on victim systems.

T1041.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
T1041.description: Adversaries may steal data by exfiltrating it over an existing Command and Control (C2) channel.

T0000.name: Benign Network Activity
T0000.description: Normal, expected system and network communication.
